subject: [hw] T01 -> V02: 4 -Wtautological-constant-out-of-range-compare warnings in n2a32_mem.c
body: With -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror, gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_mem.c:266,280,301,328 produce: comparison of constant 4294967296 with expression of type uint32_t is always false/true (a >= GUEST_SIZE / a < GUEST_SIZE, GUEST_SIZE = 1<<32). They are dead checks on a uint32_t and harmless, but they break the -Werror combined build. Please either change the comparisons to a 64-bit expression or drop them; meanwhile my combined harness build uses -Wno-error=tautological-constant-out-of-range-compare and prints the warnings. No other warning from your files, core works.
